_about: Step 2: framework knowledge as DATA (no application names). Each check adds sinks for a class. kinds: return_value (a handler's returned body is a sink), status_ctor (response object built with a 3xx status), header_write (value written to a named response header), config_gated_sink (a call is a sink only when a config call enables the unsafe setting).

checks.why: a controller that returns a raw string body writes it to the response; with an HTML content type that is reflected output
a response entity built with a 3xx status turns its headers (Location) into a redirect
writing a value to the Location response header
template output escaping disabled globally: every render call is an HTML sink
a string built from an HTML literal and a non-literal value is output markup; if the value is attacker-controlled (directly or via storage) it is XSS
MongoDB operators that execute a JavaScript string: a value assigned to them is a code/NoSQL injection sink (object literals are lowered to `obj.$where = value`)
